rules.statement: A tenant entering into possession of land under a lease void in law becomes a tenant from month to month upon the terms of the writing as far as they are applicable and not inconsistent with a monthly tenancy, and is bound to pay rent to the lessor so long as the landlord-tenant relationship exists in fact.
rules.supporting_quote: "A tenant entering into possession of land, under a written lease void in law, thereupon becomes tenant from month to month upon the terms of the writing as far as they are applicable to and not inconsistent with a monthly tenancy; and so long as the relation of landlord find tenant exists in fact, the tenant is bound to pay the rent to his lessor."
